mainEntity.name: What factors drive the overall cost of a multigenerational home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends on square footage, site layout, structural requirements, and selected interior fixtures. Ground-up room additions require foundation work, exterior tie-ins, and full framing, whereas repurposing existing footprints involves less structural erection. Key cost drivers include whether the suite requires a full bathroom, walk-in shower conversion, specialized cabinetry, or independent climate control. Clear planning during the initial estimate helps define your priorities, ensuring design choices fit your budget before work begins.
